title: Histogram
blurb: Step 15 of the learning path. Many invocations count into the same bin at once. `bins[bin] = bins[bin] + 1` would lose counts, because two invocations read the same old value. `atomicAdd` is one indivisible step, so no count is lost. The host reads eight counts, and each count is the height of one bar. Atomics run on WebGPU, on WebGL2 as the pass program of Rule 11.8 and on the CPU tier, so this step lists all three.
